ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a bar chart of water resources development and utilization rates in some regions of China, with the vertical axis as a percentage. The world average is about 30%, while the Hexi Corridor is about 70%, the Yellow River Basin is about 95%, the Junggar Basin is about 65%, and the Tarim Basin is about 70%; the water resources development and utilization rates of these regions are all significantly higher than the 40% reasonable development limit mentioned in the question stem. The Hexi Corridor, Junggar Basin, Tarim Basin and other areas are mostly arid and semi-arid regions, with strong evaporation; after irrigation, salts easily accumulate in the soil surface layer, so soil salinization and alkalization problems are likely to be triggered.

水资源利用率是指流域或区域用水量占水资源可利用量的比率。国际上一般认为，一条河流合理开发的限度是水资源利用率为40%。下图为我国部分地区水资源开发利用率示意图。

<image1>

根据图中信息，这种水资源利用状况在一些地区还容易引起什么环境问题？
